signals.name: queue.depth
signals.notes: Primary backlog signal. Rising depth alone does not prove worker starvation.

signals.name: task.mean_long_delay_duration
signals.notes: High delay suggests scheduler pressure or worker starvation, but remains interval-based evidence rather than a timeless fact.

signals.name: worker.poll.starved
signals.notes: Emitted when a worker loop makes no poll progress for one monitored interval.

signals.name: manual_review_required.external_broker_lag
signals.notes: External broker lag can mimic internal starvation and still needs operator review.
